The composition and the structure of Al2O3 deposited on the LiCoO2 electrodes were characterized by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) and X-ray diffraction (XRD). The TEM micrograph in Fig. 2 (C) shows that the outer layer of the LiCoO2 particles after 100-reaction cycles of Al2O3 ALD is very thin. The energy dispersive X-ray (EDX) spectra in Fig. 2 (E) were employed to determine the composition of the thin film.
